high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "realbarbarapalvin." The post features a black-and-white photograph of a woman standing on a street at night. She is wearing a zebra-print dress with a deep V-neckline and a fitted waist, paired with sunglasses and a long coat draped over her shoulders. Her hair is styled in loose waves, and she is waving with one hand while looking directly at the camera. The background shows a well-lit urban setting with buildings that have classical architectural details, such as columns and balconies.
